The '''EG-series power droid''' was a series of [[Power droid/Legends|power droids]] manufactured by [[Veril Line Systems/Legends|Veril Line Systems]]<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> that included the [[EG-4 power droid]], the first power [[Droid/Legends|droid]] brought to market,<ref name="FF12">{{FactFile|12|POW 1-2|Power Droids}}</ref> and its successor, the [[EG-6 power droid/Legends|EG-6 power droid]].<ref name="FF76">{{FactFile|76|POW 3-4|EG-6 Power Droid}}</ref> In response to [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] release of the nearly-identical [[GNK power droid/Legends|GNK power droid]], Veril Line Systems released the [[S9-series heavy power droid]], a larger and more expensive variation of the EG-6.<ref name="TEGtD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> Veril Line System's [[IN-4 information droid]] was built using the same basic chassis as the EG-series.<ref name="CFTD" />
